([[Lee Moldaver]]'s faction) |TV actor =[[Charlie Besso]] }} '''Tommy''' is a lead farmer {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Radio]]=== Tommy and his father [[Adam (TV series)|Adam]] use metal detectors to collect small metal objects in the desert. When they return home, Tommy empties their finding into a pot to be melted down. When they enter their home, they find [[the Ghoul]] eating a meal at their table. Things escalate when the Ghoul mentions his older brother [[Roofus]]' name and pulls out an envelope.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Say, am I out of date, or did I hear you had three kids?"''
[[Adam (TV series)|Adam]]: ''"I had an older son, but he's gone. He took up with that madwoman in the hills two years ago. We haven't heard from him since."''
The Ghoul: ''"Hmm. There's always some new little faction, ain't there? Brand-new team of believers with their own dumbass ideas about how they gonna save the world. What did you say the name of your eldest was? Was it Roofus?"''
Adam: ''"I didn't say…"''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Adam demands to know what Tommy did and what was in that envelope. The Ghoul then unfolds a blood-splattered letter with a hole in the center and claims that it was Tommy who got Roofus involved with the "madwoman," [[Lee Moldaver]]. He'd go on reading off a blood-splattered letter that said Roofus entrusted Tommy to deliver a stash of caps to a courier to deliver an [[Siggi Wilzig|Enclave defector]] to Moldaver. When the Ghoul found Roofus' body and picked up the envelope with the letter inside, he couldn't read it because of the blood-splattered hole in it. The Ghoul then asks Tommy to inform him of Moldaver's location, and he'll leave.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Now, according to this, Roofus sent Tommy a stash of caps to pay a courier for 'the safe transport of an Enclave defector' to that very same madwoman in the hills. Moldaver. But my problem is, by the time I got this letter off your brother, it was a little bit hard to read. For some reason, I just can’t make out her location. Now, you give me that location, and I'll be on my way."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Tommy apologizes to his father as Adam demands that Tommy tell him what the Ghoul wants to know, but instead pleads that he doesn't want to spend all of his life digging through dirt. On the other hand, Adam forces Tommy to tell the Ghoul what he wants, or they will all be killed, including [[Sandra (TV series)|his sister]].[[Adam (TV series)|Adam]]: ''"Tell him, son. Just tell him."''
Tommy: ''"I didn't want to spend my life digging through dirt. I want to build something, and we have the chance…"''
Adam: ''"Tell him what he wants to know! Or else he's gonna kill us all! Including your little sister."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Under pressure, Tommy reveals that Moldaver was at the [[Griffith Observatory|observatory]]. With that, the Ghoul asks Tommy if he would really allow him to leave knowing what he did to his older brother, which earns him a cold stare by Tommy. Adam claims he will not, but the Ghoul is unconvinced that Tommy would not try in the future.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"So, what you think, Tommy? Am I really walking out of here today, or are you gonna try and draw on me for what I did to your big brother?"''
[[Adam (TV series)|Adam]]: ''"He won't."''
The Ghoul: ''"Maybe not today, but maybe someday."''
Adam: ''"Tommy!"''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Just then, Tommy tries to reach for the [[flintlock musket]] beside him, but the Ghoul uses his [[Dom Pedro (TV series weapon)|revolver]] to shoot him dead. As the Ghoul leaves, Adam mourns the loss of his son. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|I didn't want to spend my entire life digging through dirt. I want to build something, and we have the chance--|Tommy explaining his motives to the Ghoul}} ==Appearances== Tommy appears only in the ''Fallout'' TV series. {{FOTV appearances|7=107}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
